features: 16W boAt Signature Sound: Upgrade your audio space with the powerful 16W Signature Sound of the boAt Aavante 2.0 150 Bluetooth Soundbar. Get lost in cinematic sound and energetic beats with its booming output.
2.0CH Portable Soundbar: With rich bass and crisp highs, this 2.0-channel soundbar brings a theatre-like audio experience right into your home, keeping you fully immersed in whatever you’re watching.
RGB LEDs: Light up your gatherings with stunning RGB LEDs. Add excitement to the mood with dazzling light effects that pulse along with your favorite tracks.

Multi-Connectivity: Connect effortlessly through various options like Bluetooth v5.4, TF Card, AUX, or USB. Whether you're streaming music or watching movies, get instant audio fun with the host of connectivity modes.
Dual Full-Range Drivers: Experience immersive gaming and binge-watching sessions with dual full-range drivers that deliver rich, balanced sound for next-level entertainment.
TWS Double Impact: Pair two Aavante 2.0 150 soundbars wirelessly with the TWS feature for a dual audio setup and double the entertainment.
5 Hours of Playback: Keep the vibe alive with up to 5 hours of continuous playtime. No more mid-marathon charging as you dive into uninterrupted fun.
Built-In Mic: Take hands-free calls with the built-in microphone, even if your phone isn’t close by. Stay connected on calls effortlessly.
Portable Design: Lightweight and easy to carry, the Aavante 2.0 150 moves with you, making it perfect for indoor lounging or outdoor chilling. Keep the good times rolling wherever you go!
